help.topic.browserPersistence.question: Where are my builds stored?
help.topic.browserPersistence.answer: In this browser, along with your preferences. Clearing site data deletes them, so export or share anything you want to keep.
help.topic.completedEngineeringGrades.qu: Why do my engineered stats differ in game?
help.topic.completedEngineeringGrades.an: Rolls vary in quality in game. Nav Beacon shows every grade at 100% quality. A partial imported grade is raised to 100%, so the module is shown at the best roll of that grade rather than at the roll you have in game. A grade that cannot be raised refuses the whole import before anything opens, and your open build stays as it was.
